source: Final 10,131 accepted QDiag V7 edits; not pilot subset
sampling: First 50 edits from each cell of the frozen seed42 random 900-edit sample; selection does not use new model outcomes.
baseline: Reuse original gpt-5.6-terra accepted verdicts; no new baseline calls
review_prompt: Byte-identical original validate_group_v7.txt and original GroupReviewResponse schema
images: Exact original reviewed reference/positive images and order, verified against historical request caches
context: All original group instructions, only sampled candidate edits; candidate batch is smaller than original
blinding: No old verdicts, old reasons or generating/review model names in model payload
api: Existing minimal HTTPX Chat Completions backend, high image detail, schema-in-prompt, max_tokens 16384, no reasoning-effort override
reports: per-cell acceptance/agreement with original accepted labels
unanimous agreement among four new reviewers
limitations: Accepted-only sample does not measure overall annotation accuracy or agreement on rejected candidates
Overall rate is a nine-cell macro-average, not weighted by full-release frequencies
Historical baseline saw more candidates per group; review rules and images are preserved
Successful API probe tests compatibility, not proof of reliable image grounding or provider model identity

local_response_compatibility.reason_length: Requested maximum remains 300 characters; complete longer reasons are retained with a format warning. All other validators remain enforced.
local_response_compatibility.verdicts: accept/reject and failure_code are never changed by compatibility handling

probe_readiness: Successful actual multimodal review is required; hello is auxiliary. Saved real responses can be revalidated offline.
